title: Story Problems within 10
short: Act out, draw and solve adding and subtracting stories.

blocks.html: Math stories tell about things joining or going away. Act them out, draw them, and write a number sentence.

items: Act it out with toys or fingers, or draw it.
Are things joining ($+$) or going away ($-$)?
Count to answer. Then check with the story.

blocks.name: k-pic
blocks.cap: 4 fish are in the pond. 3 more swim in: $4 + 3 = 7$.

blocks.html: Joining stories add. Going-away stories subtract. Act it out, then count.
Acting out or drawing shows what happens in the story. You can see whether the group gets bigger or smaller.

blocks.title: Sharing shells
blocks.q: Mia has 6 shells. She gives 2 to Ben. How many shells does Mia have now?
steps: Mia’s group gets smaller: take away.

blocks.title: Red and blue cars
blocks.q: There are 3 red cars and 5 blue cars. How many cars are there?
steps: The two groups go together: add.

blocks.html: For grown-ups: Make up stories about your child’s own things at the table. Let your child decide whether it is a + story or a − story.

sources.name: Common Core State Standards for Mathematics, Kindergarten, K.OA.A.2: solve addition and subtraction word problems within 10 using objects or drawings
